title: Install the release agents actually run, so the merged workflow fixes are active
goal: Agents drive the loop through ~/.susi/bin/susi, which changes only when a release is cut and promoted. The installed 0.21.0 was built from ee0f8269, 92 commits behind main: it released a claim taken on another branch (which main refuses), missed the fail-closed gate, the closure check against origin/main, the worktree-drift report, the installed-release drift report, the agent identity from the process tree, and the refusal of code under a claim that reserves no paths. Cut v0.21.1 with the fixes, merge it, publish the tag, promote it with scripts/susi-release-sync.sh, and verify with scripts/check-release-sync.sh that the installed release commit is on origin/main.
